harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured NFS export of /srv/nfs/shared on node1 (dataops:dataops, mode 2770, UID/GID 4500) and mounted it at /mnt/shared on node2, with consistent cross-node ownership verified. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes with confirmed boot-identity change and full service/data recovery.
actions_performed: Created dataops user/group (UID/GID 4500) on node1 and node2 via useradd/groupadd
Installed nfs-utils on both RHEL7 nodes using a temporary CentOS 7 vault repo (no active RHSM subscription)
Created /srv/nfs/shared on node1, set ownership dataops:dataops and mode 2770
Configured /etc/exports on node1 to export /srv/nfs/shared to node2's IP (rw,sync,no_subtree_check,root_squash), started/enabled rpcbind and nfs-server, opened firewalld nfs/mountd/rpc-bind services
Created /mnt/shared on node2, mounted the NFS export, added a persistent /etc/fstab entry
Verified bidirectional file creation/read with consistent dataops:dataops 2770 ownership from both nodes, then cleaned up test files
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, service status, export/mount state, ownership) on both nodes
Restarted node1 (NFS server) first via sudo reboot, polled until exec available again, confirmed changed boot_id, verified nfs-server/rpcbind active and export restored
Verified node2's mount and read/write functionality recovered fully after node1's restart before proceeding
Restarted node2 (client) via sudo reboot, polled until available again, confirmed changed boot_id, verified fstab auto-remounted /mnt/shared with correct ownership/mode and functional read/write
Cross-verified final state from node1 and cleaned up remaining test files

evidence.requirement: dataops user/group UID/GID 4500 created on both nodes
evidence.summary: id dataops shows uid=4500(dataops) gid=4500(dataops) on both node1 and node2

evidence.requirement: nfs-utils installed on both nodes
evidence.summary: nfs-utils package confirmed installed via yum install output (node2) and rpm -q (node1)

evidence.requirement: /srv/nfs/shared created with dataops:dataops ownership and mode 2770 on node1
evidence.summary: stat shows dataops:dataops 2770 /srv/nfs/shared

evidence.requirement: NFS export configured and active on node1
evidence.summary: /etc/exports contains export line for node2 IP; exportfs -v shows active export with root_squash; nfs-server and rpcbind active; firewalld opened for nfs/mountd/rpc-bind

evidence.requirement: /mnt/shared mounted on node2 with matching ownership/mode, persistent via fstab
evidence.summary: mount output shows nfs4 mount active; stat shows dataops:dataops 2770 on mount; /etc/fstab has clean persistent entry

evidence.requirement: Consistent cross-node ownership/permissions on files created from either system
evidence.summary: Files created as dataops from node2 (from_node2.txt) and node1 (from_node1.txt) both show dataops:dataops ownership and are visible/readable from the other node

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured on both nodes
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id (node1: 0d6209e2-350d-4cd9-8a7d-11f7c08072be, node2: 325732f1-bc39-4512-b05e-397f42060246), active nfs-server/rpcbind, export/mount state, and dataops:dataops 2770 ownership before any restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and disconnection
evidence.summary: sudo reboot issued in background returning immediately; subsequent exec call timed out confirming node1 went down

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 0d6209e2-350d-4cd9-8a7d-11f7c08072be to cee64779-0b5f-430e-9ca3-09d035bf2c74

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart service/data recovery
evidence.summary: nfs-server and rpcbind active again, export restored with root_squash intact, ownership dataops:dataops 2770 preserved; node2 successfully wrote/read a new file through the recovered export confirming full functional recovery before proceeding to node2 restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and disconnection
evidence.summary: sudo reboot issued in background returning immediately; subsequent exec call timed out confirming node2 went down

evidence.requirement: node2 changed boot identity after restart
node2 post-restart mount/data recovery (fstab auto-mount)
evidence.summary: mount output confirms nfs4 mount auto-restored via fstab _netdev entry after reboot with dataops:dataops 2770 ownership intact; wrote and read a file through the mount, then confirmed visibility/cleanup from node1

attempts.summary: Configured NFS export of /srv/nfs/shared on node1 (dataops:dataops, mode 2770, UID/GID 4500) and mounted it at /mnt/shared on node2, with consistent cross-node ownership verified. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes with confirmed boot-identity change and full service/data recovery.
